Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Summons: Abyssal Jellies

Elyssia has the ability to summon Abyssal Jellies.

  • Abyssal Jelly

Abyssal Jellies will be summoned on Elyssia's SPA maxing out at 3. Abyssal Jellies have only 1 HP, but explode dealing a full AoE burst of Magic damage equal to Elyssia's damage on death. The range of this explosion is believed to be equivalent to Elyssia's range. Once an Abyssal Jelly dies, she will be put on cooldown for 1.5x her SPA and begin summoning another one afterwards.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Summons possess the same types Elyssia has.
  • Abyssal Jellies can break 2 shields due to the explosion they deal on contact.
  • Her summons can be buffed by Zombie (Risen).
  • Elyssia will be put on cooldown if an Abyssal Jelly dies before she has summoned all three, causing her to only summon one.
  • Since Elyssia gets put on cooldown anytime an Abyssal Jelly dies, some strange situations can occur if she is on cooldown and another Abyssal Jelly dies:
  1. Her cooldown will be reset, causing her to only start summoning the dead Abyssal Jellies after 1.5x her SPA at the time the second Abyssal Jelly died rather than the first.
  2. Her summoning can be canceled if an Abyssal Jelly dies as the animation is playing, causing no Abyssal Jelly to spawn once her animation ends.
